body.message:
There is no issue, as the unit is already blocked for the guest. We can proceed with extending the stay for 3 months at the same rate mentioned above.

As previously advised, if a 3-month block is required, upfront payment is necessary. However, since the you have initially asked about the duration and did not confirm a full 3-month booking, we will proceed with extending the reservation for 3 months on a monthly basis at the same agreed rate.
